dedupe_keys.name: geospatial insights for spatial distribution of healthcare facilities

description: Geospatial Insights for spatial distribution of healthcare facilities​ is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Heali Mehta. The dataset has zipcodes, latitude, logitude, population,population density and a filed called hospital count which is a count of the total healthcare facilities(including pharmacies) available in that zip code. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the Dataverse metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
